resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record and the Saskatchewan tower list both place the tower in the West Block. Only an unverified visitor comment says Centre Block, so the story keeps West Block and reports the comment as a claim.

notes_for_editor: Three coordinate sets: the brief and the websiteservice entry (49.601, -109.922) agree with each other; the Firelookout.ca record gives 49.631, -109.3159; the visitor comment gives 49 deg 39 min 48.6 sec N, 109 deg 32 min 10.2 sec W (about 49.664, -109.536). The comment's point is not checked against any survey or official map, so no correction is proposed. Elevation is unresolved: the record says 1144 m (3753 ft); PeakVisor's Cypress Hills Fire Lookout says 1,373 m (4,505 ft). PeakVisor may describe a different point. Possible duplicate: data/research/ca-sk-cypress.json and data/stories/ca-sk-cypress.md cover the same Firelookout.ca record under the id ca-sk-cypress; the editor should decide which id to keep. The brief's name 'Cypress (West Block) Fire Tower' rests on the record and the websiteservice list, and the comment disputes it. Built date and removal rest only on a visitor comment; the 1931 date matches the park's founding year, so it may be a mix-up. Access is left unset because no source says whether the tower site is open. The comment's claim about thermal cameras on provincial towers was left out because it does not concern this site.
